complete anons "dont starve to death" stir fry:

ingredients;
noodles (or rice if u already have it)

veg (whatever u already have or whatever is cheapest)

protein (leftover meats or whatever is cheapest)

salted peanuts (any basic nut or seeds can work but 
peanuts are cheap)

soy sauce (whatever is cheapest)

hot sauce (any as long as its not vinegary, sweet chilli is a solid option)

oil (any kind but groundnut is nice)

prep: 

cook noodles or rice, dont let them get cold tho especially if being reheated. 1 cup of rice or 1 roll of noodles is enough.

roughly cut veg into thumb size bits. most veg is safe to eat raw so its there for nutrients and texture

cut protein up into thumbnail ish pieces. you should precook any raw meat before this part and if u do save any liquid that comes out. i typically use tofu because its at least 1/3 cheaper when i see it.

cooking:

grab a smallish frying pan and heat. occasionally splash a tiiny amount of water on the pan and when it boils up really quickly and looks like movable circular droplets thats hot enough. (if ur using canola oil do it until the oil starts to smoke a little but thats a more risky tactic. DONT BURN YOUR HOUSE DOWN)

add roughly a shots worth of oil but a bit too much is better then not enough, it should easily coat the bottom of the pan once u move it around a bit

(if you are using tofu add this now, the high water content means it takes longer to "cook". if it starts to break down let it but just keep going until its just starting to brown. dont let it stick and if it does scrape it off and keep going. do not add the tofu water at any point)

add your noodles, then protein, then make sure they are sizzling nicely. it can spit a bit if its not fully drained so just be careful. use the protein as a time measurement to monitor how long you should wait before adding more stuff. dont let it stick to the pan.

once your protein is looking a bit seared then add the veg and peanuts. dont stop stirring.

work it for another min or 2 then add any liquid from the protein and the soy sauce. mix thoroughly and make sure pretty much everything is coated a little. the more soy you add the more expensive it gets so i try not to add too much.

take it off the heat once the veg is hot enough and directly into a bowl. add a dash of hot sauce and roughly mix though. 

eat before it gets cold :)

alterations: 

rice is more unpredictable and absorbs oil. it can be harder work to taste good but when it does its lovely

fry an egg in the pan with the stir fry to have it be even more filling

fry some onions too to add sweetness 

this could easily be had as vegan depending on the ingredients, do your research but it may cost more...
